---
title: Evaluate linkage quality
---

## Precision and recall

Precision asks how many accepted links are correct. Recall asks how many true links were recovered. Which matters more depends on the analytic goal.

```{r}
true_positive <- 92
false_positive <- 8
false_negative <- 15
precision <- true_positive / (true_positive + false_positive)
recall <- true_positive / (true_positive + false_negative)
round(c(precision = precision, recall = recall), 3)
```

## Bias in downstream estimates

False non-matches can remove events unevenly across subgroups. False matches can misclassify outcomes or inflate denominators. Report linkage quality with the analysis, not as a disconnected appendix.

## Sensitivity analysis

Vary thresholds, re-run key estimates, and describe how sensitive conclusions are to plausible linkage error.
